growth_thesis.basis: Stated in P1 and P4 (virtual capacity advantage) and P2 (rate-parity risk in states without telehealth parity laws).

quotes: Our virtual care offering also allows clinicians to see more patients without investments in incremental physical space, expanding our patient visit capacity beyond in-person only levels.
